newsitem.title: CUBA: Volcano island children to get Cuban holiday.
newsitem.headline: Volcano island children to get Cuban holiday.

text.p: Children from Montserrat who have suffered badly from stress during recent volcanic eruptions on the Caribbean island are to get a holiday in Cuba to help them recover.
The children, aged 10 to 16, will arrive on Friday to spend three weeks at the beach camp of Tarara, east of the capital, the ruling Communist Party newspaper Granma said on Thursday.

Montserrat, a British colony, has suffered weeks of eruptions from the Soufriere Hills volcano that have forced evacuations to safe areas and almost completely destroyed the abandoned capital, Plymouth.
Granma said the holidays were being funded by the Red Cross organizations of the Netherlands, Spain, France, Germany, Italy, Canada and Britain, and Air Jamaica was providing transport.
Tarara has also been used to provide care for 11,000 children affected by the 1986 disaster at the Ukrainian nuclear power plant of Chernobyl.
